purpose: Check whether GBIF exposes independent collection records for the seven candidate current names from the Claver river/estuary article, with locality evidence and catalog/institution identifiers. This does not validate the paper's specimen identifications or resolve its province conflict.

screen.exactLocalityQuery: For each name, queried GBIF occurrence search with exact scientificName, country=PH, locality=Claver, limit=20. Each returned count=0.
screen.exactProvinceQuery: For each name, queried exact stateProvince=Surigao del Norte with country=PH. Each returned count=0. Two initial requests were rate-limited (HTTP 429) and were retried sequentially; the retry results were also zero.
screen.freeTextQuery: Queried country=PH&q=Claver using limit=300 at offsets 0 and 300. GBIF reported 458 total results; both pages were retrieved (endOfRecords=true at offset 300). Checked scientificName, acceptedScientificName and verbatimScientificName against all seven names; no target-name match was returned.
screen.deferredQuery: A separate country=PH&q=Surigao request reported 38,568 results with limit=1. Only its count and one unrelated sample row were inspected; the result set was not enumerated and is not used as evidence for or against any target taxon.
limits: This is a bounded GBIF-index screen, not a census of Philippine collections or of all records under alternate names and spellings.
A zero exact-field or text-search result is not evidence of absence, does not disprove the article, and does not show that a physical specimen does not exist.
GBIF indexing, provider verbatim names, incomplete locality fields and taxonomic backbones can affect search results.
The Claver article's Surigao del Norte versus Surigao del Sur conflict and missing station-by-taxon crosswalk remain unresolved.
No author, publisher, institution or collection was contacted.

interpretation: No GBIF record matching the seven checked crosswalk names was returned by the tested Claver locality, Surigao del Norte stateProvince, or completely paged Philippines-wide Claver free-text searches. Therefore this screen found no independent local voucher; it does not establish absence or invalidate the article. Without a matched occurrence carrying usable collection identifiers, no GBIF record can be treated as a specimen-level corroboration. The article remains research-only.

references.supports: Official GBIF occurrence API reference, including occurrence search and its page limit.
Official Darwin Core term descriptions for locality and stateProvince, and definitions for collection/institution identifiers.
